play: Every hit on the holder is cut down to a ceiling, a share of its max HP, a lasting answer to big hitters where Aegis stops one blow and ends.
needs_block: A status field that cuts each hit on the holder to a set share of its max HP; block stops one hit whole, then ends.

question: price
play: Damage to the holder comes out of an ally's MP instead of its HP, so a caster with a deep pool spends fuel keeping the unit drawing fire whole.
needs_block: A soak setting that draws on another unit's MP, such as the source's; soak draws only on the holder's own.

question: timing
play: When a foe starts a wind-up, a reaction shields or arms whichever ally that action is aimed at, so protection lands where the blow will fall.
needs_block: A target rule that picks the ally a foe's action under way is aimed at; no rule reads a foe's chosen target, and that target may be fixed only as it resolves.

question: size
play: Each hit's damage on the holder is held back and paid out over the following ticks instead of at once, so spikes become a trickle that Regen and heals can match.
needs_block: An Owed-like debt that pays out its stacks on a pulse over its length; debt lands only when it runs out.

question: size
play: Lockouts on party units land shorter and then not at all, as control resistance does for bosses, a gradual answer where immunity is all or nothing.
needs_ruling: vocabulary.md, 'Statuses are universal': control resistance is bosses' alone.

question: size
play: The party mends for a share of the damage its foes take from Burn, Bleed and Shock, a steady heal that needs no hits.
needs_ruling: vocabulary.md, 'A status scales by its stacks, never by its applier': a status's damage belongs to its holder, with no lifesteal from it.

question: size
play: An effect sets off all of a Regen's remaining pulses at once, turning a slow mend into a sudden one when an ally drops low.
needs_ruling: vocabulary.md, 'A status runs its own course': no ability spends, shortens or sets off a status early.
